name: 02_benchmark_pre_git_release
description: Benchmark of 2 models x 2 topologies on the 30-scenario set, before deploys became git releases. results.jsonl is the primary cohort and is byte-identical to results_dual_deepseek_deepseek_v4_flash_latest.jsonl; summary.md describes it, comparison.md the four cohorts. Formerly eval/results_*.jsonl, eval/comparison.md and eval/history/02_pre_git_release_dual_deepseek/.

judge.note: The verdicts, the swap picks and the judge cost were not stored: the judge figures in summary.md and comparison.md cannot be recomputed. Calibration used the synthetic draft labels, now eval/labels/synthetic_draft_labels.json.

stale_reason: Recorded with the system prompts that enumerated the scenario classes, before the stop reason was scored, and on an earlier scenario file (see scenario_file_sha256). Not comparable with a run of the current harness; kept as a historical record only.
